project.name: osgi/domains/crypto
project.description: The crypto seam-realisations — the cross-cutting modules that seal / convert key material for whoever needs it, grouped because none belongs to a single consumer domain: ssh-to-age-edge (shells ssh-to-age, converts an OpenSSH key to an age key — used by manifests and cluster-pki), sops-process (the ONE sops runner, dual-realm, driven by sops-edge and by the host's SopsAtRest), sops-edge (shells sops through it, seals a YAML for age recipients — the node's sops-nix envelope), and cellar-cipher-age (pure-Java age via jagged, seals the seed-broker cellar's SEALED entries with the rke2-cluster ssh key directly). Each fills a seam owned lower (SshToAgeConverter, SopsEncryptor, CellarCipher); this group only aggregates them so the layout mirrors the concern.
